name: brandon-35-plugins
description: Open-source Claude Code plugins and mods by Brandon Ta.

plugins.name: git-graph
plugins.description: A commit graph of every branch in a pane beside the chat; pick a commit to see its details and diff.

plugins.name: blame-lens
plugins.description: Inline git blame for the lines Claude edits, under the Edit's row and on the status line, plus /blame for any file or line range.

plugins.name: git-history
plugins.description: The history of one file in a pane beside the chat, following renames; pick a commit to see that file's diff.

plugins.name: git-compare
plugins.description: Compare two refs or two folders in a pane beside the chat; pick a changed file to see its diff.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Browse the open pull requests of the current repository in a pane beside the chat: files, diffs, reviews and comments. Read-only, through the gh CLI.

plugins.name: github-theme
plugins.description: GitHub Dark and GitHub Light color themes for the terminal interface, picked with /theme.

plugins.name: one-dark-pro
plugins.description: The One Dark Pro color theme for the terminal interface, picked with /theme.

plugins.name: todo-tree
plugins.description: Every TODO, FIXME, HACK, BUG and XXX comment tag of the repository in a pane beside the chat; pick one to see its context.

plugins.name: bookmarks
plugins.description: Mark lines in files, list them in a pane beside the chat, and jump back to the code around each one.
